t: You're looking at Twelve Responses to Tragedy, also called the Yalta Memorial, in the Yalta Memorial Garden on Cromwell Road. Twelve bronze busts sit on a stone base. The memorial remembers people displaced by the Allied repatriation of Soviet citizens after the Second World War, which the Yalta Conference mandated. The sculptor is Angela Conner, who works in London. This version was dedicated in 1986, replacing an earlier memorial from 1982 that vandals repeatedly damaged.
